pictures.name: JUK1-The-Doorway
pictures.prompt: Tall 9:16 contemplative sacred oil painting, lifelike faces, rich textiles, deep blue shadows, warm gold lamplight, main subject in the middle of the frame, no text or letters, no logos. Night in an ancient Babylonian town of mud-brick houses. Mar Ukba, a scholar in his fifties with a greying beard, in a dark brown robe and a cream head covering, bends by the plain wooden door of a humble house and quietly slips four small coins into the stone socket at the base of the door frame. Moonlight, a single distant lamp glowing gold, deep blue shadows. Quiet, secret kindness.

Night, inside a large dome-shaped clay baker’s oven whose fire has been swept out; only a faint warm glow remains on the curved walls, no flames. Mar Ukba, a scholar in his fifties with a greying beard, in a dark brown robe and a cream head covering, and his wife, a warm, quick-eyed woman in her fifties in a deep indigo dress and a saffron head scarf, crouch close together, hiding, his feet resting on top of hers, both holding their breath, faces tender and determined.
